items.originalTitle: 💬 “It’s difficult to put into words what I’m feeling right now. I’m still trying to process it all, but to be able to say that I am world champ...
items.summaryEn:
💬 “It’s difficult to put into words what I’m feeling right now. I’m still trying to process it all, but to be able to say that I am world champion is just incredible. This is a moment that I will remember for the rest of my life.”
Hear from World Championship winner Kimi, George, Toto and Shov 👇
https://bit.ly/RaceReportMexicoCityTW
detailZh:
💬 “现在很难用言语表达我的感受。我还在努力处理这一切，但能够说出我是世界冠军真是太不可思议了。这将是我一生中永远铭记的时刻。”
听听世界冠军基米、乔治、托托和肖夫的看法 👇
https://bit.ly/RaceReportMexicoCityTW
detailEn:
💬 “It’s difficult to put into words what I’m feeling right now. I’m still trying to process it all, but to be able to say that I am world champion is just incredible. This is a moment that I will remember for the rest of my life.”
